title: How he got the nickname Punch: twin sister Judy
summary: His twin sister Ernestine Judy gave them the names Punch and Judy; she died in 1926.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Now tell us, how did you get your name Punch? How did you get that nickname?
Oh, that nickname was from twins. We were twins. My sister's name, Ernestine Judy Miller, and my name is Ernest Punch Miller. So that's why we got the name. They called us Punch and Judy.
Is that a real middle name Judy?
Yeah, that's a real middle name. That's no joke. She's still living? No, my sister died in 1926. I left right after she died.
